evidence.description: A fingerprint on an office drawer came back as an apparent match to the Seattle man

notes: Only the month is given, as early June, and the time is described as night. Three businesses on one row of storefronts were struck: an insurance agent, an Indian restaurant and a cafe. The fingerprint match is to a Seattle man, and police in King County knew his name as early as 6 Jul. The Herald article does not say which of the two defendants committed each incident.
